description: This PHP class 'PimCsvDataImportService' provides functionality for importing PIM (Personal Information Management) data from CSV files, including header definitions, and methods to get/set a CsvDataImportService dependency and to perform the import operation.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportService
classes.description: Service class that handles importing personnel information from CSV data, defines header row values, manages dependency on CsvDataImportService, and provides an import method.

methods.name: getCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Returns the instance of CsvDataImportService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Performs CSV import by delegating to CsvDataImportService's import method, passing the content, import type, and header row values.
